session-expired: Your sign-in has lapsed. Your marks are safe on this device; sign in again and they go to your Library.
wire-lapsed: Your agent no longer accepts the reader's permission. Sign in again to grant it; nothing on this device is lost.
your-content-empty-highlights: Verses you highlight will show up here.
about-hero-body: A Bible for those you do life with. Read and study Scripture together, online, on any device, in dozens of languages.
about-playlist-body: Gather passages, links, and videos into a path through Scripture to walk through or share.
about-sessions-body: Read live with your group, wherever each of you is. Everyone follows along in their heart language.
about-shared-body: See which chapters your friends have been reading, and stay in the Word together, even on different schedules.
about-content-body: Highlight what speaks to you and write down what you're learning. Your friends' notes show up right in the passage too.
about-mission-body: We believe access to God's Word should stay simple and dependable. Seed Bible is free forever, with no ads, no paywall, and nothing between you and Scripture.
your-content-empty-saves: Passages you save will show up here.
bookmark-move-hint: Tap a bookmark to move it to this chapter.
feed-empty-notes: No notes in this time frame yet.
policy-unavailable: This text is not available in your language yet.
about-estate: This build runs on the faithnet estate: your marks live in your own Library at your Home, written by your own agent; this app keeps nothing of yours. Public things you publish are released from your shelf and indexed by the Seed registry.
profile-note: Private until you publish it; published, your friends see the name, line and picture in their Today.
connectors-none: No MCP servers are connected to your agent.
connectors-note: Attached at your Home; this reader only lists them and never calls them.
publish-as-note: As a church you steward, what you publish — notes, playlists, plans, themes — lands on the church's shelf and reaches everyone who follows it.
account-wire-held: Your highlights, notes and bookmarks go to your Library through your own agent.
account-no-wire: No wire: your marks stay on this device.
first-run-playbook: Your agent does not offer the reader's behaviour yet. Open your Home once — it gives your agent the behaviour by itself — then come back here: the reader retries on its own.
account-signin-title: Keep your marks in your Library
account-signin-blurb: Sign in with your Home. This page holds no key; your Home does the ceremony.
try-sample-people: Or try it as one of the Home's sample people
audio-auto-continue: When a chapter's recording ends, play the next chapter
presence-share: Let friends see what I am reading right now
presence-share-note: Only people who have added you back see it, and only while this tab is open; it fades by itself.
onboarding-read: Read any translation, highlight, write notes, keep bookmarks — it all works right here on this device, even offline.
onboarding-home: Sign in with your Home and your marks go to your own Library, through your own agent — nothing of yours is kept by this app.
onboarding-together: Read together: start a live session and friends follow you; publish a note and it reaches their Today.
scripture-map-blurb: Every chapter of the open translation. Shaded by how often you have read it; a dot marks a highlight or note; the chapter on screen is outlined.
new-playlist-title: New playlist, starting with the passage on screen
customization-maker-blurb: A branded reader: colours for light and dark, a logo, a default translation. Publish it and readers can pick it under Church theme.
recommended-extensions-note: Turned on for a reader who picks this theme; they can turn any off.
customization-link-hint: A link that opens the reader in this theme
plan-maker-blurb: A plan from the chapter on screen, one chapter a day, up to chapter:
annotation-conflict: This note was edited on two devices. Both versions are kept until you choose one.
note-link-hint: A link that opens these verses with your published note
select-verses-to-note: Select a verse and tap Note to write one.
session-start-blurb: Start a session on the chapter you have open: you lead, friends follow you, and everyone sees your marks for the session.
session-guest-blurb: No Home? Join as a guest with the share code: you follow along and chat; nothing of yours is kept.
session-record-kept: The record is in your Library:
voice-note: Voice is peer to peer between the devices on it (${state.voice.connected.value.length} connected); no server hears it. Some networks will not connect without a relay.
session-allow-guests: Let guests (no Home) join with the share code
discover-no-body: This release has no text beside it.
discover-empty: Nothing released for this chapter yet. Publish one of your notes to be the first.
discover-how: The Seed registry indexes what people and churches release on their public shelves; it re-crawls every 15 minutes.
today-signed-out: Sign in to see your friends and what they released.
today-no-friends: No friends yet. You are friends once you have added each other at your Home.
today-no-contacts: No contacts yet. Friends are the contacts at your Home.
today-feed-empty: Nothing released by your friends yet.
today-how: Friends see only what you publish. Your private marks never leave your Library.
companion-blurb: Ask about the chapter on screen (or the verses you selected). The answer comes from the estate's study model, not from a person.
compare-select: Select verses in the reader, then tap Compare.
places-none: This chapter names no place the map knows.
places-no-geometry: The map has no geometry for these places yet.
transcript-sign-in: Sign in to transcribe a recording.
transcript-note: The recording is decoded on this device and sent in two-minute pieces to the estate's speech model; nothing is kept, and nothing goes to any other service.
transcript-save-note: Save as a note on this chapter
twitch-bad-channel: That is not a Twitch channel name.
twitch-none: Name a channel to watch its stream and chat beside the text. Nothing you do here is sent to Twitch.
twitch-readonly: Twitch's own player and chat. Posting in chat happens on Twitch, under your Twitch account, never through this app.
